discipline_notes: Every VERIFIED here was re-derived from the evidence file AND the filesystem, not read off the probe's status field.
record_source must be 'live': the probe's own rule is that a repository fixture is not evidence.
No digest of a live record file is recorded: those files are append-only, so a digest would change every run and the check would be ignored.
probe_evidence_digest hashes the NORMALISED evidence (volatile keys stripped), which is why it is stable across runs.

probe.measurement: read-only probe; never pauses, steers or cancels a real agent
